sources.title: moondream/parakeet-ultra · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Long-form Eleven complete TED-LIUM 3 talks of 10-20 minutes each. parakeet-ultra transcribes them through Photon, whose segmenter cuts each talk at pauses found by the model's VAD head into segments of at most 30 seconds; the original runs NeMo's own long-audio path.

sources.title: Introducing Moondream Parakeet Redux and Parakeet Ultra
sources.snippet: The same examples work with Parakeet Ultra on an NVIDIA GPU by changing the model to "moondream/parakeet-ultra" and the device to "cuda". Both models choose the language automatically and preserve punctuation and capitalization. Find when each word was spoken Use timestamps="word" to get a transcript with sentence segments and word timings.

sources.title: Moondream Parakeet Ultra | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Moondream Parakeet Ultra is a full-precision automatic speech recognition (ASR) model derived from NVIDIA's Parakeet framework, built for GPU deployment where maximum transcription accuracy is the priority over compactness or CPU efficiency. Unlike its compressed sibling, Parakeet Redux, Ultra retains the original model's full-precision weights.
